title: Multi-Modal Approach for Quality Control and Failure Analysis of Metal Lines for Chiplets Integration
content: Advanced packaging solutions for chiplets integration require increasingly high-density interconnects to substrate, metal pads small line/space redistributing layers (RDL). 3D integration requires advanced thermal compression bonding and hybrid bonding to achieve the necessary interconnect density for high bandwidth chiplets communication. As a result, the characterization of structural integrity, electrical properties and bonding interface for different classes of advanced packaging technologies is currently critical for pushing the boundaries of next-generation electronic devices.
